text: Something fell out of it. With a boot on.

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Well I'll be. A visitor! Nobody visits.

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Not since King Daniel sealed the forest. With me in it.
You've been stuck in here the whole time?

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Went out for kindling. Came back, there's a magic wall. Nobody told me.
Uh, where's your other leg?

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Boar ate it. Big ugly thing, up in the wallow north of the trail.

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Had my good boot on, too. Bring 'em back and I'll make it worth your while.
You want me to fetch your leg. Out of a boar.

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Leg AND boot. The boot's the important bit.

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Isn't she lovely? Gonna hang her right over the fire.
It's a leg, Burt.
Give Burt his leg
Ask about the seal
Leave
Here. One leg, slightly chewed. Boot included.

speaker: &current_sprite
text: My boot! Still laced, too. Look at that.
Are you going to... put it back on?

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Don't be daft, boy. I'm having it stuffed. Over the fireplace.

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Here. Took this off a tax collector the boar didn't finish.
150 gold! Your leg was worth every bite.
Why'd the King seal this place, anyway?

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Folk say it's to keep people out.

speaker: &current_sprite
text: Folk are idiots. You don't build a wall that strong to keep a thing OUT.
I'm going to pretend you didn't say that.
Burt's leg. Still warm. I'm not thinking about why.

speaker: &current_sprite
text: By decree of King Daniel this forest is SEALED. Do not enter. Do not feed it.
Whoa. The air in here is all thick. Like Mom's porridge.
So THIS is what King Daniel sealed shut.
Nobody seals a forest unless there's something good in it.
